content.title: Why Steven Madden (SHOO) Stock Is Trading Up Today
content.summary: Shares of shoe and apparel company Steven Madden (NASDAQ:SHOO) jumped 4.8% in the morning session after Piper Sandler upgraded the stock to 'Overweight' from 'Neutral' and significantly raised its price target.

content.title: Steven Madden upgraded on fashion rebound, Crocs cut on share concerns
content.summary: Investing.com -- Piper Sandler raised its rating on Steven Madden to Overweight on expectations of a recovery in fashion trends and growth from its Kurt Geiger brand, while downgrading Crocs to Neutral, on market share risks in clogs and continued headwinds at Heydude.
